verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a reconciliation report suite that covers the breakdown half of the story well. It includes a Payouts Report, a Financial Actions by Payout ID Report, and a Settlement Breakdown Report, which together map each payout to its underlying financial actions and fee categories. Nothing in the evidence shows a finance-ops user can set or change the payout schedule; the stablecoin settlement option changes the destination, not the timing. Missing for 10: documented payout-schedule control (frequency or timing configuration), explicit evidence that refunds and fees are itemized per payout, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
